# Replica Pack, clone any app — reverse-engineer it, rebuild it, test it for bugs, then fix what its users hate

Curated by Skill Harbor: the full Replica pack in one listing. Eleven free skills that clone any app, run in order: recon, architect, design, build, backend, test, diff, entrepreneur, brand, launch and deploy. Each step reads what the last one wrote in a replica folder, from a recon map of screens, flows and features to a rebranded app shipped live on your own domain. It rebuilds what an app does, never what it owns: no original code, logos, copy, content or private APIs, no testing the original's servers, and no launch under the original's identity.
